annotations.title: Build an AliExpress basket within a budget

description: Plan a set of complementary products for one need ("home gym starter set", "kit to start baking bread", "camping cooking gear") and fill it with real AliExpress listings whose total stays within the budget. Each item has a role (what it is for), price, rating, order count, a link and a few alternatives. Prices are for delivery to the given country, in its currency. By default only free-shipping listings are used, so the total is what the buyer pays for the items. Links are affiliate links (OneFindMe may earn a commission; the price is the same for the buyer).

budget.description: Total budget in the delivery country's currency.

country.description: ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 delivery country, e.g. US, GB, DE, IL. Default US.

language.description: Language for role names (ISO 639-1). Default: detected from the need, else en.

need.description: What the basket is for, in any language.

recipient.description: Who or what it is for, if relevant.

name: build_basket
